# oZen Salon & Spa

> Hair, lash & skin studio based in Round Rock, Texas. Color, cuts and extensions with master stylist Kerem, and lashes, facials and skin care with paramedical esthetician Kara, in a calm, classy salon on S Lewis St.

- Phone: (512) 249-8900
- Based in: Round Rock, TX
- Nearby areas: Round Rock, Georgetown, Pflugerville, Hutto, Cedar Park, Austin
- Yelp and Google rating: 4.9 from 126 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/texas/ozen-salon-and-spa/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/texas/ozen-salon-and-spa/book.html

## Services
- Color, balayage & highlights: Dimensional color, honey balayage and soft blonding, built gradually so your hair stays healthy.
- Cuts, blowouts & styling: Precision cuts, face-framing layers and a wash and blowout clients call the best they've had.
- Hair extensions: Long, seamless extensions installed and maintained by Kerem, color matched to your own hair.
- Lash extensions & brows: Kara's lash work is what dozens of our reviews talk about. Full sets, fills and brow tinting.
- Facials & skin care: Facials, peels and paramedical skin treatments from Kara in a quiet, calming room.
- Bridal hair & airbrush makeup: Hair and airbrush makeup for weddings, photos and big nights out.

## About
oZen Salon & Spa is owned by husband and wife Kerem and Kara Ozen. Kerem is our master stylist and color specialist. Kara is a paramedical esthetician who does lashes, facials and skin treatments. Hair, lashes and skin, all under one roof. In June 2023 we moved from Anderson Lane in Austin to 107 S Lewis St in downtown Round Rock: the yellow building with the cedar posts. Inside you'll find a navy accent wall, cream tufted chairs, a pink neon sign and a quiet room for facials. Everything is by appointment, so every client gets our full attention. People tell us the salon feels like a sanctuary, and that's exactly what we want it to be.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: We're by appointment only. Book online through Vagaro or call (512) 249-8900. If you need something soon, call: we'll do our best to get you in on short notice.
- Q: Where are you, and where do I park?
  A: 107 S Lewis St, Suite 140, in downtown Round Rock: the yellow building with cedar posts. There's street parking and a private lot.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday 9 AM to 5 PM, Thursday 1 PM to 8 PM and Saturday 8 AM to 3 PM. Closed Sunday and Monday.
- Q: Can you fix hair another salon damaged?
  A: Often, yes. Many of our clients came to Kerem after a bad experience elsewhere. He'll look at your hair, make a plan and take big changes in stages so your hair stays healthy.
- Q: Do you do both hair and lash extensions?
  A: Yes. Kerem installs and maintains hair extensions, and Kara does lash extension full sets and fills.
- Q: How can I pay?
  A: We take credit cards and Apple Pay.
